post.description:
Text → stops for the traveller to review (nothing is saved). Signed in only: the demo
uses ready-made samples, so anonymous callers never spend on extraction.

get.description:
Server-sent events: everything so far, then each new event until done or error.
Reconnecting with Last-Event-ID resumes after that event.

delete.description:
Deletes the user and, by ON DELETE CASCADE, every itinerary, version, run, violation,
fix, preference and setting they own.

CheckStart.title: CheckStart
CheckStart.description: Exactly one of: a saved version (signed in) or a demo sample (no sign-in).

StopIn.title: StopIn
StopIn.description:
A stop as the traveller confirmed it (parse step 5). Keep osm/lat/lon from the parse
result for stops the traveller didn't change; leave them out for edited ones and they are
looked up when the check runs.
